title: Sub-Agents Not Detected: Missing Agents in CLI List Despite Directory Creation
body:

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.62

top_comments.author: ant-kurt
top_comments.body:
Issues with custom agents, file search, and custom slash commands on Windows should be resolved for CMD and Powershell in 1.0.63, which released today but is not yet tagged as `latest`.

Downgrading to 1.0.61 will also mitigate.

top_comments.author: ant-kurt
top_comments.body: ACK - we're aware of issues with the native Windows installer specifically, and are working to resolve it. If you're seeing this on the `npm` installation, let us know.

top_comments.author: ant-kurt
top_comments.body:
See https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/5185 - there are some workarounds in the comments.

This issue (4623) was related to a Windows-specific issue, which has been resolved.
